text:
Maya S: FYI OrionPay wants to run a 2-week POC to replace VendorX API. Main asks: prompt parity, response formatting, and enterprise SSO/KMS needs. Can we support a near drop-in?
Alex P: short answer: mostly yes, but there are caveats around tokenization and deterministic response drift.
Maya S: can you be more specific on the caveats so I can put in the SOW?
Alex P: sure. differences we see: 1) tokenization -> token counts differ (billing implications), 2) sampling/temperature defaults differ (response variance), 3) streamed vs buffered responses (client expectations).
Devon R: security note: they require BYOK + Azure AD SSO. Our Private deploy supports customer KMS and SAML/OIDC SSO, but we need network egress rules in the POC env.
Jordan L: pricing Q: for a 2-week POC with 100k tokens/day what do we propose — hosted trial credits or a minimal Dedicated short-term commit?
Priya K: propose: hosted with a pre-paid credit + option to add transient Dedicated burst for tail latency tests. That avoids a long commit and covers SLA tests.
Maya S: OrionPay legal also asked about data retention and audit logs in the POC. Devon, can we provide scoped audit logs?
Devon R: yes — we can enable per-tenant audit logs and export to their SIEM. Will need an IP allowlist and HMAC signing for webhooks.
Alex P: on prompt parity: recommend a 3-step approach for the POC: 1) shim adapter to normalize request/response surface (small proxy), 2) shared prompt templates + eval set, 3) A/B runs vs VendorX with metrics.
Maya S: can you paste an example shim snippet?
Alex P: here —

```
# simple proxy mapping
POST /v1/generate -> map to /v1/redwood/generate
body.prompt = normalizePrompts(body.prompt)
headers['x-corp-tenant'] = "orionpay"
```

Alex P: keep it lightweight — just do token normalization, set deterministic sampling params, and fix streaming framing.
Jordan L: billing: call out token normalization in SOW so we don't under/over-bill. also include a clause for model variant fallback (e.g., quantized vs full) and its cost delta.
Priya K: deliverables for POC: setup guide, shim repo, eval harness (10 canonical prompts + scoring), SSO/KMS runbook, and a cost model doc. I'll own the repo + runbook.
SecBot: Security questionnaire link: https://internal.redwood/sec-templates/pci-poc-checklist (automated scan scheduled).
Maya S: next steps: Alex/Priya to pair on shim repo by EOD tomorrow, Devon to draft security/KMS integration note, Jordan to propose POC pricing options. I'll consolidate into the presales deck.
Alex P: ack. I'll drop a minimal template in the sales drive and tag @Maya S. :thumbsup:
Devon R: starting the Azure AD notes now, will ping if infra needs changes.
Jordan L: I'll DM finance for a quick quote matrix.
Priya K: creating repo + initial eval set, ETA end of day tomorrow.
Maya S: thanks team — aim to get this into OrionPay by Friday for kickoff.
